'''2007 Georgia State Championship Jeff Anderson DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeff Anderson]] at [[2007 Georgia State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' All your base are belong to Derdram (V)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
